unknown_precedence: Unknown takes precedence even when another gate fails. Preserve all known failure codes; UNKNOWN is always excluded.
revision_evidence: TRANSFORMATION_INVARIANT is supplementary evidence, never an availability class or a universal correction guarantee.
source_schedule_decision: Yahoo quote delay and JPX expected publication day do not bind the cached daily vintage or guarantee historical daily-bar finality. No derived timestamp authorized.
absolute_ma_rule: MA20 and MA60 require a vintage observed before the target cutoff or independently verified historical basis; uniform future scaling is insufficient.
outcome_rule: Exact ticker/session, known source/hash/field semantics, same Open/Close basis, resolved action integrity and verified same-factor revision or known vintage are all required.
official_preference: Prefer admitted JPX on exact ticker/session; numeric/parser validation alone is not source admission.
overlap_tolerance_basis: Existing historical_data_quality_policy numeric_tolerance; no broader market discrepancy tolerance introduced.
outcome_conflict: SKIPPED_OUTCOME_INTEGRITY; no average, repair or silent fallback
